# Loona Design Studio

> Free online design tools by Loona Automation. Every tool runs 100% in the visitor’s browser: no sign-up, no uploads, no watermarks.

## Start Here — The Studio Core

- [Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/chart-maker/): All-in-one chart maker: bar, line, pie, doughnut and more from one table.
- [Photo Collage Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/photo-collage-maker/): 2–9 photos into grid, hero and mosaic collages.
- [Logo Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/logo-maker/): Brand logos with icons, fonts, schemes and transparent PNG.
- [Poster / Flyer Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/poster-maker/): Posters and flyers on A4, square, story and more sizes.
- [Mind Map Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/mind-map-maker/): Branching mind maps with tidy auto-layout and JSON save.
- [Drawing Whiteboard](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/drawing-whiteboard/): Sketch pad with pen, shapes, eraser and undo/redo.
- [Flowchart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/flowchart-maker/): Flowcharts with smart elbow connectors.
- [Business Card Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/business-card-maker/): Print-ready 3.5 × 2 in cards at 300 DPI.
- [Screenshot Beautifier](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/screenshot-beautifier/): Screenshots on gradient backdrops, share-ready.
- [Image Annotation Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/image-annotation-editor/): Arrows, labels and privacy blur for screenshots.
- [Favicon Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/favicon-generator/): Full favicon pack: ICO + PNGs + manifest in a ZIP.

## Charts & Data Visualisation

- [Bar Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/bar-chart-maker/): Grouped bar charts from a table or CSV.
- [Column Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/column-chart-maker/): Vertical column charts for reports and slides.
- [Line Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/line-chart-maker/): Multi-series trend lines over time.
- [Area Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/area-chart-maker/): Filled area charts that show volume.
- [Pie Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/pie-chart-maker/): Exact-proportion pies with percentages.
- [Doughnut Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/doughnut-chart-maker/): Ring charts with the total in the centre.
- [Horizontal Bar Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/horizontal-bar-chart-maker/): Ranked sideways bars for long labels.
- [Stacked Bar Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/stacked-bar-chart-maker/): Totals built from coloured parts.
- [Scatter Plot Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/scatter-plot-maker/): X vs Y points with a least-squares trend line.
- [Bubble Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/bubble-chart-maker/): Lively bubble version of the scatter plot.
- [Radar Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/radar-chart-maker/): Spider charts for profile comparison.
- [Histogram Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/histogram-maker/): Distributions from raw numbers, auto-binned.
- [Box Plot Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/box-plot-maker/): Box-and-whisker plots from real quartiles.
- [Funnel Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/funnel-chart-maker/): Conversion funnels with stage percentages.
- [Gauge Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/gauge-chart-maker/): Speedometer gauges for KPIs and goals.
- [Waffle Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/waffle-chart-maker/): 10×10 grids where each square is 1%.
- [Polar Area Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/polar-area-chart-maker/): Nightingale coxcomb charts for cycles.
- [Pictogram Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/pictogram-maker/): Isotype dot charts anyone can count.
- [Venn Diagram Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/venn-diagram-maker/): Two- and three-circle Venn diagrams.
- [Treemap Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/treemap-maker/): Squarified treemaps with exact areas.
- [CSV to Chart](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/csv-to-chart/): Paste CSV, pick from 16 chart types.

## Diagrams & Maps

- [Concept Map Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/concept-map-maker/): Concepts joined by labelled, meaningful links.
- [Org Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/org-chart-maker/): Org charts from simple indented text.
- [Family Tree Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/family-tree-maker/): Clean three-generation family trees.
- [Timeline Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/timeline-maker/): Events on an axis, sorted by year.
- [Mermaid Diagram Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/mermaid-diagram-maker/): Paste Mermaid code, get a diagram PNG.

## Templates — Posters, Cards, Covers & More

- [Flyer Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/flyer-maker/): Print-ready A4 and Letter flyers.
- [Banner Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/banner-maker/): Web banners, covers and headers at exact sizes.
- [Infographic Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/infographic-maker/): Tall step and statistics infographics.
- [Letterhead Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/letterhead-maker/): A4 business letterheads, print or PDF.
- [Menu Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/menu-maker/): Café and restaurant menus with prices.
- [Book Cover Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/book-cover-maker/): 6×9 and Kindle-ratio book covers.
- [Album Cover Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/album-cover-maker/): Square music and podcast cover art.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/youtube-thumbnail-maker/): Exact 1280 × 720 thumbnails that earn clicks.
- [YouTube Banner Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/youtube-banner-maker/): Channel art with the safe area built in.
- [Quote Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/quote-maker/): Quote images over photos or colours.
- [Invitation Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/invitation-maker/): Birthday, wedding and event invitations.
- [Greeting Card Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/greeting-card-maker/): Eid, birthday and thank-you cards.
- [Ticket Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/ticket-maker/): Event tickets with a tear-off stub.
- [ID Card Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/id-card-maker/): CR80 staff and student ID cards.
- [Calendar Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/calendar-maker/): Correct printable month calendars.
- [Announcement / Sign Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/announcement-maker/): Open/Closed, sale, notice and welcome signs.

## Photo Boards & Splitters

- [Moodboard Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/moodboard-maker/): Free-arrange photos, swatches and notes.
- [Vision Board Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/vision-board-maker/): Goal photos + affirmations, poster & wallpaper sizes.
- [Instagram Grid Splitter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/instagram-grid-splitter/): One photo into a 3×N profile grid (ZIP).
- [Carousel Splitter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/carousel-splitter/): Wide images into swipeable panels (ZIP).
- [Image Grid Splitter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/image-grid-splitter/): Any image into an exact N×M tile grid (ZIP).

## Avatars & Icons

- [Initials Avatar Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/initials-avatar-maker/): Name avatars with a colour from the name.
- [Pixel Avatar Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/pixel-avatar-maker/): Seeded identicons + custom 5×5 pixel avatars.

## Words & Pixels

- [Word Cloud Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/word-cloud-generator/): Weighted word clouds from any text.
- [Pixel Art Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/pixel-art-editor/): Sprite grids with pen, fill and crisp export.

## Colour & CSS Generators for Developers

- [Colour Shades Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/color-shades-generator/): Full 50–950 tonal scale from one colour.
- [Colour Harmony Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/color-harmony-generator/): Six colour-wheel harmony schemes.
- [Colour Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/color-converter/): HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK in one view.
- [Colour Mixer](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/color-mixer/): Blend two colours in even steps.
- [Random Colour Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/random-color-generator/): Six fresh random colours per roll.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/css-gradient-generator/): Multi-stop linear, radial and conic CSS.
- [Text Gradient Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/text-gradient-generator/): Gradient headline text in CSS.
- [Mesh Gradient Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/mesh-gradient-generator/): Aurora mesh gradients in pure CSS.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/box-shadow-generator/): Visual CSS shadow designer with presets.
- [Text Shadow Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/text-shadow-generator/): CSS text shadows with live preview.
- [Border Radius / Blob Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/border-radius-generator/): Organic blob shapes via border-radius.
- [Clip Path Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/clip-path-generator/): CSS clip-path shapes and polygons.
- [CSS Button Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/css-button-generator/): Design buttons, get production CSS.
- [CSS Spinner Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/css-spinner-generator/): Pure-CSS loading spinners with keyframes.
- [Glassmorphism Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/glassmorphism-generator/): Frosted-glass cards in CSS.
- [Neumorphism Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/neumorphism-generator/): Soft-UI neumorphic shadows.
- [Cubic Bezier Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/cubic-bezier-generator/): Visual CSS easing-curve designer.
- [CSS Triangle Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/css-triangle-generator/): Border-trick triangles in four directions.
